evidence_items.publisher: arXiv; Stephanie Lin, Jacob Hilton and Owain Evans
evidence_items.explanation: TruthfulQA documents false-answer generation in GPT-family and other models on questions designed to elicit misconceptions. It does not manipulate reference, cognitive models or compositionality, so the reported failures do not establish the causal claim.

GopherCite adds retrieved supporting evidence and preference-based training, yet does not improve this truthfulness measure. This cautions against equating source grounding with truth, but does not refute the broader claim involving all three linguistic factors.

unresolved_gaps: The benchmark failures do not identify the cause of poor truth discrimination.
The grounding intervention is not a controlled manipulation of all three proposed capabilities.
The cited generation results do not directly measure every model’s ability to classify supplied statements as true or false.
